question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lasts**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option is '**lasts**.'
 
• **'is lasting'** is used when the sentence is in the present continuous tense.
 
• **'lasted' ** is used when the sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **'last'** is used as a noun, a verb, or an adjective.
